name: @w6w-apps/drip
description: Manage Drip subscribers, tags, events and email series campaigns.

w6w.longDescription:
Drip is an email marketing platform built around subscribers, tags and custom events, and this app covers that core loop: creating or updating a subscriber, listing and fetching them, applying and removing tags to drive segmentation, and recording the custom events Drip's automations key off — 'Logged in', 'Started a trial', and the like.

Campaigns (Drip calls its automations 'Email Series Campaigns') can be listed and fetched so a workflow can look up an active series before subscribing someone to it, and account, custom-field and event-action listings round out the picture for building forms and mappings without opening Drip's dashboard.

A fit for syncing subscriber and tag data from a signup form or CRM, recording product events that trigger a Drip automation, or looking up campaign and account metadata as part of a larger workflow.
